baseline_models.focus_anchor: The interrogative comparison أفنجعل ... كـ joins a state-producing نجعل to المسلمين and المجرمين.
baseline_models.mechanism: The verse tests an act of placing or turning two opposed predicates into one status: soundness and freedom from defect on one side, guilt and offense on the other.

activation_trace.role: Turning something into a state makes نجعل the operation that would impose equivalence.
Soundness and freedom from injury supply the positive state carried by المسلمين.
Guilt and offense supply the opposed state carried by المجرمين.

changed_reading.before: Will the two named groups receive different outcomes?
changed_reading.after: Can the divine act of status-making coherently collapse soundness and culpability into the same evaluative condition?

baseline_models.focus_anchor: المسلمين and المجرمين can be heard as opposed directions of agency within the same comparative frame.
baseline_models.mechanism: One predicate carries handing over and letting go; the other carries earning or causing an incurred consequence. The rejected likeness flattens release toward another into acquisition that returns as liability.

activation_trace.role: State-making supplies the proposed conversion of unlike agencies into one standing.
Handing over and letting go make surrender a relational release rather than merely a label.
Earning and causing to incur make criminality an acquired consequence-bearing action.

changed_reading.before: Muslims and criminals are two fixed identities.
changed_reading.after: The nouns condense contrary relational motions: yielding what one holds versus acquiring what one must answer for.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: The root fields of المسلمين and المجرمين permit a material contrast between sound integrity and severance.
baseline_models.mechanism: Soundness holds a thing intact, while cutting or harvesting removes a part from its living continuity. نجعل asks whether an imposed order could treat integrity and severing as materially alike.

activation_trace.role: Making something into being supplies the ordering act under interrogation.
Soundness supplies intactness as one pole of the comparison.
Cutting and harvesting supply severance as the other pole.

changed_reading.before: The verse contrasts morally good and bad collectives.
changed_reading.after: It also asks whether preserving wholeness and producing severance can be assigned an indistinguishable form.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: نجعل can activate naming, while the two definite plurals present rival classifications.
baseline_models.mechanism: The likeness is not only an outcome but a possible act of saying or classing one kind as another. The question challenges the validity and authority of that classification.

activation_trace.role: Saying or naming makes نجعل a possible classificatory act.
Soundness gives one classification substantive content rather than a bare title.
Offense gives the counter-classification substantive content.

changed_reading.before: The question promises unequal treatment after identities are already settled.
changed_reading.after: The question also audits the act by which unlike moral descriptions would be named, entered, or treated as one class.

context_deltas.mechanism: Pen, written line, assay, and distinguishing mark turn the baseline naming model into diagnostic inscription: the contrast in 68:35 is a finding made visible and recordable, not arbitrary favoritism.

activation_trace.role: Naming anchors the changed reading in the classificatory possibility of نجعل.
The prepared writing implement supplies the means by which a distinction can become a record.
The ordered written line supplies inscription rather than an ungrounded label.
Assaying metal or persons supplies a process through which concealed quality becomes evident.
A mark that distinguishes and guides supplies the legible criterion separating the classes.

structural_cues: The surah moves from writing in 68:1 through reciprocal seeing in 68:5 and assay in 68:6 to discriminating knowledge in 68:7.
The branchless و س م cue at 68:16 contributes only the structural prospect of a visible mark; no branch identifier is assigned to it.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies writing, assay, and distinguishing marks; I infer that they converge on an evidentiary classification in 68:35, while they may instead remain separate rhetorical motifs.

changed_reading.before: God simply prefers one already named group over another.
changed_reading.after: The unequal classification is presented as the legible result of disclosure and testing, as though conduct has written the distinction that judgment reads.

context_deltas.mechanism: The garden owners withhold good, plan to cut the crop, contract against entry, and end deprived. This activates المجرمين as cutters whose exclusionary cut returns upon them, while المسلمين carries the contrary motion of handing over and release.

activation_trace.role: Handing over and letting go anchor the circulating, non-withholding pole of the contrast.
Cutting and harvesting anchor المجرمين in the garden's repeated material action.
Withholding the hand from giving supplies the social motive later enacted against the poor person.
Palm harvesting supplies the intended literal cut that closely activates the focus root's harvest branch.
A severed piece supplies the garden's transformed state as the consequence mirrors the plan.
Prevention and contraction supply the owners' exclusionary posture at the moment of action.
Deprivation and loss supply the returned result: those who meant to exclude now name themselves excluded.

structural_cues: Across 68:17-27, intended harvest, exclusion of the poor, the garden's becoming like a cut thing, and the owners' deprivation form a reversal.
The focus question follows their confession and the announcement of opposed gardens in 68:34.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies withholding, harvest-cutting, contraction, and resulting deprivation; I infer a reciprocal arrow in which the social cut rebounds on the cutters, though the sequence can also be read as punishment without lexical reciprocity.

changed_reading.before: Criminals are generic sinners contrasted with believers.
changed_reading.after: The criminals are legible as agents of severance: they cut produce and beneficiaries apart, acquire that act, and are themselves cut off from what they tried to monopolize.

context_deltas.mechanism: The garden owners turn toward their Lord and hope for substitution, while Jonah is selected and made among the sound-doing. These transitions prevent المسلمين and المجرمين from hardening into biological castes: جعل places persons into accountable states that can be revised through response and mercy.

activation_trace.role: Turning a person into a state anchors the focus categories as placements rather than essences.
One thing standing in place of another supplies the owners' live horizon of changed condition.
Directed desire supplies their relational turn toward the Lord after confession.
Selection and drawing near supply the initiating mercy in Jonah's changed placement.
The repeated state-making verb directly demonstrates that جعل can relocate a person into a new collective standing.
Sound action opposed to corruption supplies the destination of Jonah's placement.

structural_cues: The garden owners move from wrongdoing and excess in 68:29-31 to desire toward their Lord in 68:32.
The exact sequence فجعله من الصالحين in 68:50 provides a later grammatical demonstration of divine placement among a class.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies confession, redirected desire, substitution, selection, and a later making-among; I infer category permeability under response and mercy, while an alternative keeps only Jonah's case reversible.

changed_reading.before: The verse fixes two immutable kinds of human being.
changed_reading.after: The verse refuses equal valuation of two present standings without denying movement between them; its distinction is morally real but not caste-like.

context_deltas.mechanism: The questions after 68:35 demand a judgment, book, chosen entitlement, oath, and guarantor. They turn نجعل into an adjudicative classification whose contrary claim must produce a warrant.

activation_trace.role: Naming anchors the focus question as a disputed classification.
Judgment between parties names the act immediately demanded after the focus comparison.
A written establishment that imposes a ruling supplies the missing documentary warrant.
Entering a name in a register or group concretizes the classificatory force of making one group like another.
Choosing what one prefers exposes the self-serving entitlement that the alleged book would guarantee.
Bearing a guarantee supplies the personal surety demanded for the rival judgment.

structural_cues: The uninterrupted interrogation in 68:36-41 repeatedly asks who authorizes, records, guarantees, or shares responsibility for the proposed equivalence.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies judgment, binding writing, registry, choice, and guarantee; I infer a burden-of-proof procedure aimed at the equality claim, though each question can be read more generally as ridicule of false entitlement.

changed_reading.before: The verse is only a declaration that rewards will differ.
changed_reading.after: It opens a forensic hearing: anyone claiming equivalence must identify the judgment, registry, covenant, or guarantor that could authorize it.

context_deltas.mechanism: Those later unable to prostrate had formerly been called while سالمون. Soundness was an available capacity; surrender was the response that could have enacted it. المسلمين therefore becomes more than a communal title, and equality with المجرمين would erase the difference between exercised and refused capacity.

activation_trace.role: Handing over and letting go anchor المسلمين as enacted surrender.
Ability and capacity supply the later incapacity that exposes an earlier unused possibility.
The call and verbal inclination supply the invitation to convert capacity into response.
Lowering and submission supply the concrete act that was refused while still possible.
Being sound and free of impairment supplies the earlier condition in which response remained available.

structural_cues: The temporal reversal in 68:42-43 places present inability after a prior summons issued while they were sound.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies call, prostration, capacity, and prior soundness; I infer that المسلمين names sound capacity realized as surrender, while سالمون may alternatively denote only bodily ability.

changed_reading.before: Muslims are simply the members of one named group.
changed_reading.after: They are heard as those who convert an available condition of soundness into responsive self-lowering before that capacity closes.

context_deltas.mechanism: Stepwise taking and extended time activate المجرمين as an acquired and completed trajectory. The questioned likeness concerns endpoints formed through different histories, not an instantaneous sorting of static types.

activation_trace.role: Turning into a state anchors the eventual standing as something formed.
Earning or causing to incur anchors the standing in accumulated action.
Completed and cut-off time supplies an exploratory endpoint image within the focus root.
Taking degree by degree supplies the hidden incremental process by which the endpoint forms.
Extension and respite in time supply the duration within which acquired conduct matures.

structural_cues: The declaration of gradual drawing in 68:44 is immediately followed by temporal respite in 68:45.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies degrees, delay, earning, and completed time; I infer a trajectory from repeated acts to settled standing, while the alternative is simply delayed punishment after classification.

changed_reading.before: The verse compares two timeless labels.
changed_reading.after: It compares standings produced by histories: one cannot erase the accrued direction of conduct when judging the formed endpoint.

context_deltas.mechanism: The fee, binding liability, and heavy burden in 68:46 sharpen جرم's earning-and-incurring branch. المجرمين becomes an accountability term for those carrying what their acts have entered against them.

activation_trace.role: Earning and causing to incur anchor criminal standing in acquired liability.
Compensation for work supplies one side of the verse's explicit accounting scene.
A financial liability that adheres supplies the obligation imagined as resting on them.
Loading with a burden supplies the felt weight of incurred obligation.

structural_cues: The question in 68:46 couples a demanded fee with the possibility that its hearers are burdened by liability.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies wage, attached liability, burden, and the focus root's earning branch; I infer an accountability ledger, while the immediate question may only deny that prophetic payment explains rejection.

changed_reading.before: A criminal is defined chiefly by a stigmatized essence.
changed_reading.after: A criminal is one who has acquired and now carries an answerable liability; unequal standing tracks what has been incurred.

context_deltas.mechanism: The closing scene shows opponents trying through speech to unseat the messenger by assigning him madness, while the discourse is reaffirmed as a reminder and document of right. This makes the naming branch of نجعل a contest over whether a spoken designation can truly constitute standing.

activation_trace.role: Saying or naming anchors the focus comparison in the power and limits of designation.
Saying what is not so or attributing it to another supplies the opponents' false constitutive claim.
Covering the mind with madness supplies the damaging category they try to impose.
Sliding a thing from its station supplies the intended social effect of the hostile label.
A document of right supplies a stable counter-record to hostile speech.

structural_cues: In 68:51-52, attempted visual displacement and the spoken label مجنون are answered by the assertion that the discourse is nothing but a reminder for all worlds.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies false attribution, madness, displacement, and a right-document; I infer that 68:35 distinguishes warranted divine classification from hostile social labeling, while the closing attack may be independent of the focus comparison.

changed_reading.before: Making the two groups alike concerns only their final treatment.
changed_reading.after: It also concerns who can make a designation hold: hostile speech may try to manufacture identity, but a label without truth cannot establish the standing it asserts.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is surprising because نجعل is a finite verb in a comparative construction, not the noun جعالة; it remains anchored by the focus root's stipulated-reward branch and the surah's repeated wage/liability frame. Render it only as an economic analogy that colors allocation, never as a replacement translation of نجعل.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: نجعل carries a branch for assigning recompense, while the compared collectives occupy the object and likeness slots.

activation_trace.role: A stipulated reward for work supplies the form-distant recompense coloring within the focus verb's root.
Recompense and wage supply the opening promise of payment for work.
The repeated wage term makes compensation an explicit question after the focus verse.
Adhering financial liability supplies the negative side of the same accounting analogy.

changed_reading.before: نجعل only means placing one class in the same state as another.
changed_reading.after: At the edge of the root field, the question also sounds like an allocation problem: could recompense be assigned as though surrendered service and incurred liability were equivalent accounts?

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This cross-domain reading is surprising because pen-trimming, written lines, and harvest-cutting are not identical senses. It remains valid as an anchored material network around جرم's cutting branch and the explicit garden cuts. Downstream prose should call it a recurrent image of differentiation, not claim that every cited word literally means criminality.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: المجرمين supplies the cutting/harvesting branch inside a construction that asks whether a distinction will be maintained.

activation_trace.role: Cutting and harvesting anchor the material network in the focus noun.
Cutting and paring a hard object to level it supply the crafted edge from which writing begins.
A line of striking and cutting supplies the boundary-making aspect of inscription.
Cutting and separation supply the garden action that turns moral distinction into material event.
A detached piece supplies a late echo of separation, even though the surface imperative means leaving.

changed_reading.before: The comparison draws an abstract moral boundary.
changed_reading.after: A recurrent cutting image lets the boundary feel made: the pen is pared, a line is cut, the harvest is severed, and المجرمين names those implicated in destructive cutting.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is surprising because the snakebitten sense is a lexical counter-name and should not translate المسلمين or سالمون. It remains anchored in the shared سلم inventory and becomes live beside the prior-soundness scene. Render only as a paradoxical resonance: called sound can name vulnerable hope or yielding under injury, not assured invulnerability.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: المسلمين activates the سلم branch in which the snakebitten is called sound either hopefully or because the injury has been yielded to.

activation_trace.role: The wounded person counter-named sound supplies paradoxical, non-triumphal soundness within the focus root.
The same counter-naming branch makes سالمون capable of carrying a fragile or hopeful resonance beside ordinary ability.
The summons supplies the moment at which vulnerable soundness is asked to become response.

changed_reading.before: The Muslim side represents an untouched, self-secure wholeness.
changed_reading.after: At the exploratory edge, its soundness can include vulnerable or hopeful yielding: integrity is not immunity from injury but a way of answering while exposed.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is surprising because سلم as ladder is nominally distant from المسلمين, and درج supplies both ordinary steps and ominous gradual taking. It remains anchored by exact packet branches and the focus's state-making comparison. Render as a spatial analogy for opposed trajectories, not as lexical equivalence.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: المسلمين carries a ladder-or-means branch, while نجعل can turn persons into a state.

activation_trace.role: A ladder or means supplies an ascending spatial trajectory within the focus predicate's root field.
State-making anchors the question in where differing trajectories finally place their subjects.
Taking degree by degree supplies a counter-trajectory whose smooth progress conceals its direction.
Extended time supplies the span across which the graded movement unfolds.

changed_reading.before: The two collectives stand side by side as static classes.
changed_reading.after: They can also appear at the ends of unlike graded movements: one takes a means of responsive ascent, while the other is drawn by degrees along an apparently easy descent.

strongest_changes: The garden narrative turns المجرمين from a generic moral label into cutters whose attempted severance of crop from beneficiary returns as their own deprivation.
The post-focus legal questions make the comparison a warranted classification requiring judgment, record, and guarantor.
The سالمون-to-inability sequence makes المسلمين an enacted use of available soundness, while Jonah's later making-among صالحين keeps standing real but revisable.
Gradual drawing, respite, wage, liability, and burden recast criminal standing as an accrued and answerable endpoint rather than an essence.
summary.what_was_special: The focus roots become unusually concrete across the surah: soundness becomes surrender under available capacity, جرم becomes harvest-cutting and incurred liability, and جعل becomes inscription, adjudication, and reversible placement. The readings coexist without reducing the verse to one axis.
remaining_uncertainties: The reciprocal-cutting model is strongly activated by the garden sequence, but the causal rebound remains reader-supplied rather than grammatically stated in 68:35.
It remains open how much المسلمين should carry soundness versus handing-over in this occurrence.
The reward, wounded-soundness, cut-line, and ladder readings are branch-valid resonances but too form-distant to use as direct translations.
The reversible-status reading should not dissolve the verse's present moral distinction into eventual sameness.
